items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: He was bass horn player in that jazz band. I took his job away from him with George Corley's Royal Aces.

ctx.x: And this would be around Austin, mostly, would it?
Yeah, they was all local musicians. And then George Corley (PHONETIC) took it over, and that it became George Corley and his Royal Aces.
